Make a shy surprised expression with a faint painted pink blush, bring both little hands to her cheeks, briefly peek at the viewer, then lower both hands.

The face, chest, hips, knees and both shoe toes all point left; one near eye is visible and the far eye is naturally occluded. NEVER walk facing the viewer, never move toward or away from the camera, never backpedal, and do not show a front-facing marching gait. By second 8 stop stepping. During seconds 8 to 10 turn back to the original FRONT neutral stance, ending with empty hands and the original shoe baseline.
